routes.source_domain: real symmetric PSD tensor fields with matrix marginal KL
routes.target: complex pure-state token and relation effects with independently normalized Born overlap
routes.hypothesis: Use tensor transport as an explanation or direct replacement of current attention
routes.result: Distinct pure rays force PSD coupling blocks to zero. Strict-PD literal KL has no finite marginal; ordinary closed-PSD KL admits only zero coupling if no rays match.
routes.boundary: Only this specific PSD-block/matrix-marginal construction; not all quantum transport.
routes.repair: Full-rank regularization changes the method; explicit single-pair limit differs from Born overlap.
routes.novelty: Known PSD support argument and log-Euclidean specialization; no novelty claim

routes.novelty: Known Bayes-risk specialization; no novelty claim
